title: uac_registrant Module
content_markdown: The module enable OpenSIPS to register itself on a remote SIP registrar.
overview: The module enable OpenSIPS to register itself on a remote SIP registrar.

exported_parameters.name: hash_size
exported_parameters.description: The size of the hash table internally used to keep the registrants. A larger table distributes better the registration load in time but consumes more memory. The hash size is a power of number two.

exported_parameters.name: timer_interval
exported_parameters.description: Defines the periodic timer for checking the registrations status.

exported_parameters.name: failure_retry_interval
exported_parameters.description: Defines a custom interval to retry the registration upon error/failure. Normally, after any kind of failure (timeout, credentials, internal error), the registration is re-taken after "expires" seconds. The parameter here, if set, overrides that value.

exported_parameters.name: enable_clustering
exported_parameters.description: This parameter enables the clustering support in the module. This is used to share this registration between all the nodes in the cluster. When using this option, you should define (for each registrant record) a sharing tag - this sharing tag will control at the cluster level which node is entitled to perform the registation (only the node having that tag as active will do the registation, the onther nodes being idle).

exported_parameters.name: db_url
exported_parameters.description: Database where to load the registrants from.

exported_parameters.name: table_name
exported_parameters.description: The database table that holds the registrant records.

exported_parameters.name: registrar_column
exported_parameters.description: The column's name in the database storing the URI pointing to the remote registrar (mandatory field). OpenSIPS expects a valid URI.

exported_parameters.name: proxy_column
exported_parameters.description: The column's name in the database storing the URI pointing to the outbond proxy (not mandatory field). An empty or NULL value means no outbound proxy, otherwise OpenSIPS expects a valid URI.

exported_parameters.name: aor_column
exported_parameters.description: The column's name in the database storing the URI defining the address of record (mandatory field). The URI stored here will be used in the To URI of the REGISTER. OpenSIPS expects a valid URI.

exported_parameters.name: third_party_registrant_column
exported_parameters.description: The column's name in the database storing the URI defining the third party registrant (not mandatory field). The URI stored here will be used in the From URI of the REGISTER. An empty or NULL value means no third party registration (the From URI will be identical to To URI), otherwise OpenSIPS expects a valid URI.

exported_parameters.name: username_column
exported_parameters.description: The column's name in the database storing the username for authentication (mandatory if the registrar requires authentication).

exported_parameters.name: password_column
exported_parameters.description: The column's name in the database storing the password for authentication (mandatory if the registrar requires authntication).

exported_parameters.name: binding_URI_column
exported_parameters.description: The column's name in the database storing the binding URI in REGISTER (mandatory field). The URI stored here will be used in the Contact URI of the REGISTER. OpenSIPS expects a valid URI.

exported_parameters.name: binding_params_column
exported_parameters.description:
The column's name in the database storing the binding params in REGISTER (not mandatory field). If not NULL or not empty, the string stored here will be added as params to the Contact URI in REGISTER (it MUST start with “;”.

If the following two params are present, then the binding will be enforced to be unique (if two bindings are received in a 200ok, a complete binding removal will be performed before re-registering):

*   _reg-id_
    
*   _+sip.instance_
    
Example of params that will force unique binding:

;reg-id=1;+sip.instance="<urn:uuid:11111111-AABBCCDDEEFF>"

exported_parameters.name: expiry_column
exported_parameters.description: The column's name in the database storing the expiration time (not mandatory).

exported_parameters.name: forced_socket_column
exported_parameters.description: The column's name in the database storing the socket for sending the REGISTER (not mandatory). If a forced socket is provided, the socket MUST be explicitely set as a global listening socket in the config (see “socket” core parameter).

exported_parameters.name: cluster_shtag_column
exported_parameters.description: The column's name in the database storing the cluster sharing tag in \[tag\_name/cluster\_id\] format (not mandatory). If a cluster sharing tag is provided, the REGISTER requests will be fired out only when the tag is active.

exported_parameters.name: state_column
exported_parameters.description: The column's name in the database storing the current state of the registrant. When a registrant is disabled, OpenSIPS will no longer send REGISTERs for it. A value of _0_ for this column means enabled and _1_ disabled.

exported_parameters.name: reregister_expiry_percentage
exported_parameters.description: Percentage describing how much sooner a RE-REGISTER needs to be send based on the Expiry. a 100 value means the RE-REGISTER will be send right on the edge of expiry ( old behavior ), which might lead to registration loss. a 90 value means the RE-REGISTER will be sent sooner , at 90% of the Expiry, etc.

exported_mi_functions.name: uac_registrant:list

parameters.name: aor
parameters.description: URI defining the address of record. If provided, _contact_ and _registrar_ parameters are also required and only a specific record will be listed.

parameters.name: contact
parameters.description: Contact URI. If provided, _aor_ and _registrar_ parameters are also required and only a specific record will be listed.

parameters.name: registrar
parameters.description: URI pointing to the remote registrar. If provided, _aor_ and _contact_ parameters are also required and only a specific record will be listed.

return_value.description: Lists the registrant records and their status.

exported_mi_functions.description: Replaces obsolete MI command: _reg\_list_. Lists the registrant records and their status.

examples.code: opensips-cli -x mi uac\_registrant:list sip:alice@opensips.org  sip:alice@127.0.0.1:5060 sip:opensips.org

parameters.name: aor
parameters.description: URI defining the address of record.

parameters.name: registrar
parameters.description: URI pointing to the remote registrar.

return_value.description: Enables a specific registrant. OpenSIPS will immediately send a REGISTER if the registrant was previously disabled and will update the state in the database.

exported_mi_functions.name: uac_registrant:force_register

parameters.name: aor
parameters.description: URI defining the address of record. If provided, _contact_ and _registrar_ parameters are also required and only a specific record will be forced to re-register.

parameters.name: contact
parameters.description: Contact URI. If provided, _aor_ and _registrar_ parameters are also required and only a specific record will be forced to re-register.

parameters.name: registrar
parameters.description: URI pointing to the remote registrar. If provided, _aor_ and _contact_ parameters are also required and only a specific record will be forced to re-register.

return_value.description: Forces the re-registration (or registation) of a specific registrant (depending on its state). Note that the registrant must be enabled.

exported_mi_functions.description: Replaces obsolete MI command: _reg\_force\_register_. Forces the re-registration (or registation) of a specific registrant (depending on its state). Note that the registrant must be enabled.

examples.code: opensips-cli -x mi uac\_registrant:force\_register sip:alice@opensips.org  sip:alice@127.0.0.1:5060 sip:opensips.org
examples.description: Force re-registration of a specific registrant.

exported_mi_functions.name: uac_registrant:upsert

parameters.name: registrar
parameters.description: URI pointing to the remote registrar

parameters.name: binding_params
parameters.description: params to be added to the registration

parameters.name: expiry
parameters.description: number of seconds that the registration will be valid

parameters.name: forced_socket
parameters.description: opensips socket to send out the register out through

parameters.name: cluster_shtag
parameters.description: the sharing tag for this registration

return_value.description: Inserts or updates the in-memory contents of the AOR/Contact/Registrar. No Database queries are done when calling this MI command, all parameters are passed via MI.

examples.code: opensips-cli -x mi uac\_registrant:upsert aor=sip:vlad@test.com contact=sip:test@localhost registrar=sip:127.0.0.1:5061 proxy="" third\_party\_registrant="" username="vlad" password="1234" binding\_params="" expiry=60 forced\_socket="" cluster\_shtag="" state=0

exported_events.name: E_REGISTRANT_REGISTERING
exported_events.description: This event is raised when the module sent the initial REGISTER and started the registration process.

exported_events.name: E_REGISTRANT_AUTHENTICATING
exported_events.description: This event is raised when the initial REGISTER has been challenged and a new REGISTER with credentials has been sent out.

exported_events.name: E_REGISTRANT_REGISTERED
exported_events.description: This event is raised when a REGISTER has been 200 OKd.

exported_events.name: E_REGISTRANT_REGISTER_TIMEOUT
exported_events.description: This event is raised when a REGISTER received no reply from the registrar.

exported_events.name: E_REGISTRANT_INTERNAL_ERROR
exported_events.description: This event is raised when a REGISTER procesing was stopped due to an internal OpenSIPS error.

exported_events.name: E_REGISTRANT_WRONG_CREDENTIALS
exported_events.description: This event is raised when a REGISTER with credentials was still rejected by the registrar

exported_events.name: E_REGISTRANT_REGISTRAR_ERROR
exported_events.description: This event is raised when a REGISTER is rejected by the registrar with a non-standard sip code.

exported_events.name: E_REGISTRANT_UNREGISTERING
exported_events.description: This event is raised when a de-REGISTER is sent by OpenSIPS.

exported_events.name: E_REGISTRANT_AUTHENTICATING_UNREGISTER
exported_events.description: This event is raised when a de-REGISTER is challenged and auth is sent by OpenSIPS.
